column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus v262144 wild spawner slot conditions (spawner_data.bin + encount_data.bin in bin/archive/field/resident_release.gfpak)
# note: One row per spawner x encounter slot; complements data/field_spawn_table.tsv (same spawner_id / encount_key).
# note: alpha = 3 guaranteed perfect IVs (slot field 25, LIKELY); unique_alpha = slot flag table bit 1 (weight-100 fixed alphas, LIKELY).
# note: time_*/weather_* = effective multiplier: slot value, -1 -> species default (poke_encount.bin), default -1 -> 1.0; 0 = never (LIKELY).
# note: condition = slot condition (type:comparator:args); random alphas carry flag FSYS_NS_<area>_CLEARED. Spawner gates: field_spawn_table.
# note: slot_raw = the slot's 12 stored floats (absent = 0); species defaults: world_events_species_time_weather.
